$comment: Membership plans. A pass has two parts: what you drink (sub-tier: how much one pass covers) and how often you go (tier: passes a month). Edit names, pass counts, daily maxes, prices and quiz copy here; no code changes needed. Amounts are in cents. Ids never change (Stripe and the database use them); names are free to change. stripePriceEnv names the env var holding that plan's Stripe Price ID. quiz holds the 'Get matched' answers and each plan's result line.
